guide.title: How to use AgroAI Advisor
guide.lead: This page go show you wetin each part of the website dey do and how you go take use am, step by step.

banner.title: You be new here?
banner.body: Read small guide wey go show you wetin AgroAI Advisor fit do and how to use am.

s1.b: As you log in, you go land for your dashboard. E dey show your recent crop checks, today weather and the crops wey you dey grow.

s2.b: For "About your farm", add the crops wey you dey grow and small note. The advisor dey use am make the advice fit your farm.

s3.b: Press "Check crop" to send photo, or "Ask question" to type or talk.

s4.t: Follow the steps, or ask person
s4.b: Read wetin to do. If e serious, or I no sure, send the summary give extension officer.

check.b: Choose the crop, snap the leaf or plant wey dey worry you, then add small word about wetin you see. You go see wetin I see, why I think so, how sure I be, and wetin to do.

ask.b: Type your question, or hold the microphone button and talk. Ask about pest, planting, or whether you fit spray today. You fit correct the words before you send.

weather.b: Choose your town to see the weather now and for the next 5 days, with simple note on wetin e mean for your farm.

farm.b: For the dashboard, add your crops and notes. We dey remember your saved checks and recent chat, so the advice go be about your farm, no be farms in general.

account.b: Change the text size, the colour, and whether make answers dey read for mouth. You fit also delete your history or your whole account.

language.b: Use the English and Pidgin buttons for top of the page to change language any time.

photo.title: How to snap good photo
tips: Come close, make the leaf full the picture.
Hold your phone steady and use good daylight.
Snap the part wey dey worry you, no snap the whole farm.
If the photo blur, snap another one. I go tell you if I need clearer one.
Add small word like "leaves dey turn yellow". E dey help.

read.title: How to read the answer
read.body: "How sure I be" dey tell you how much you fit trust am: Sure, Fairly sure or Not sure. "Wetin fit change my mind" dey list things wey you go check for your farm. Start with the cheap steps under "Wetin to do". E no dey give chemical dose: always follow the label and your extension officer.

limits.title: Wetin you must remember
limits.body: E fit wrong, and e no fit touch your plants or test your soil. If the plants dey worse quick-quick, or plenty dey affected, go see extension officer.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.body: We no dey save your photos. Your account dey keep your crop checks (the answer only) and your recent chat, and nobody else no fit see them. You fit delete them any time for My account.

landing.title: Clear and correct help for your farm, for English or Pidgin.
landing.lead: Take photo of sick leaf, ask question with your voice or type am, and get advice wey fit your weather and your crops. If I no sure, I go talk am and send you go extension officer.

s1.b: Take photo of the leaf or plant wey dey worry you. Add small word about wetin you see.

s2.t: Reason dey, no be only verdict
s2.b: You go see wetin I see, why I think so, how I sure reach, and wetin fit change my mind.

s3.b: Follow simple steps wey start with cheap ways. If e serious or I no sure, send the summary give extension officer.

example.label: Example of answer
example.see: Twist leaves with pale yellow and green patches, and the plant small pass the ones near am.
example.step: Comot the worst plants today, burn or bury dem, so white flies no go carry the virus go other plants.
example.note: Na example of how e dey look, no be real farmer result.

crops.title: Crops wey I sabi well
crops.body: Cassava, yam, maize, plantain, cocoyam and pepper, with the pests and sicknesses wey common for Akwa Ibom. For other crops, I go give general advice and tell you say I sabi less.

remember.title: Advice wey sabi your farm
remember.body: If you get account, I go remember your town, the crops wey you dey grow, and wetin happen before, so the advice go be for your farm. We no dey save your photos, and you fit delete everything any time.

honest.title: Wetin I no fit do
honest.body: I fit make mistake. I no fit touch your plants or test your soil. For animal, health, money or law matter, abeg see correct professional. I no go ever give chemical dose: always follow the label and your extension officer.
